cases.question: 我飞机半夜才落地，折腾到店估计一点多，还进得去不？

knowledge.question_zh: 最晚几点可以办理入住？
knowledge.answer_zh: 客房从15:00起可入住。前台不通宵值守；已确认身份的住客可自助进入，我们会在21:00前发送指引。预计午夜后到达，请在当天20:00前告知。
knowledge.question_en: How late can I check in?
knowledge.answer_en: Rooms are available from 3:00 p.m. The desk is not staffed overnight; guests whose identity has been confirmed may use self check-in, and instructions are sent by 9:00 p.m. If you expect to arrive after midnight, tell us before 8:00 p.m. that day.

knowledge.answer_zh: 入住当天10:00后可寄存已封好的行李，贵重物品请随身携带。
knowledge.question_en: Can I leave luggage before check-in?
knowledge.answer_en: Sealed luggage may be stored after 10:00 a.m. on the arrival day. Please keep valuables with you.

knowledge.question_zh: 晚上几点后要保持安静？
knowledge.answer_zh: 22:00至次日08:00为安静时段，请降低电视和谈话音量。
knowledge.question_en: When do quiet hours begin?
knowledge.answer_en: Quiet hours run from 10:00 p.m. to 8:00 a.m.; please lower television and conversation volume.

key_facts: 已确认身份的住客可自助进入
预计午夜后到达，请在当天20:00前告知
cases.notes: 用红眼航班和凌晨抵达的场景表达替代入住时限词面。

cases.question: My laptop needs to get online for a video call—how do I connect?

knowledge.question_zh: 客房无线网络怎么连接？
knowledge.answer_zh: 每间客房书桌上的信息卡写有Wi-Fi名称和密码；连接住客网络即可。客房不提供有线网口。
knowledge.question_en: How do I connect to the room Wi-Fi?
knowledge.answer_en: The card on the desk in every room shows the Wi-Fi network name and password. Join the guest network; there is no wired Ethernet port in the room.

knowledge.answer_zh: 七间客房均配有一张书桌和一把椅子，桌面宽约九十厘米。
knowledge.question_en: Is there a desk in the room?
knowledge.answer_en: All seven rooms have a desk and chair; the desktop is about ninety centimetres wide.

knowledge.answer_zh: 客房电视可收看本地数字频道，也可在住客网络下使用投屏。
knowledge.question_en: Which channels are available on the TV?
knowledge.answer_en: Room televisions receive local digital channels and also support casting on the guest network.

key_facts: The card on the desk in every room shows the Wi-Fi network name and password.
there is no wired Ethernet port in the room
cases.notes: 用视频会议和上网场景测试英文网络语义召回。

cases.question: 屋里闷热的话能自己调凉一点吗？

knowledge.answer_zh: 每间房都有独立空调，可在18至30摄氏度之间调节；冬季制热也由同一面板控制。离开客房时请关闭空调。
knowledge.question_en: Can I adjust the room temperature?
knowledge.answer_en: Every room has independent air conditioning adjustable from 18 to 30 degrees Celsius. The same panel controls heating in winter. Please switch it off when leaving the room.

knowledge.answer_zh: 卫生间照明旁有独立排风开关，使用后可继续开启十分钟。
knowledge.question_en: How is the bathroom ventilated?
knowledge.answer_en: A separate extractor switch sits beside the bathroom light; it may be left on for ten minutes after use.

knowledge.answer_zh: 冬季床品按季节更换，衣柜上层另放一条薄毯。
knowledge.question_en: Are warm duvets provided in winter?
knowledge.answer_en: Seasonal bedding is used in winter, with an extra light blanket on the top shelf of the wardrobe.

key_facts: 每间房都有独立空调
可在18至30摄氏度之间调节
cases.stub_reply: 每间房都有独立空调，可在18至30摄氏度之间调节。
cases.notes: 用闷热和调凉表达测试温控事实，并校验受支持回复。

cases.question: After a late hike, will the shower still run warm around 1 a.m.?

knowledge.answer_zh: 淋浴热水全天供应。长时间未使用时先放水约二十秒，水温稳定后再进入淋浴区。
knowledge.question_en: Until what time is hot water available?
knowledge.answer_en: Hot water for showers is available around the clock. If it has not been used for a while, run the water for about twenty seconds and enter the shower only after the temperature settles.

knowledge.answer_zh: 公共入口22:30后自动上锁，住客可使用自己的门禁凭证进入。
knowledge.question_en: Is the entrance locked at night?
knowledge.answer_en: The shared entrance locks automatically after 10:30 p.m.; guests may enter with their own access credential.

knowledge.answer_zh: 每位入住人一条浴巾，已折叠放在洗手台下方的干燥层。
knowledge.question_en: Where are the bath towels?
knowledge.answer_en: One bath towel per registered guest is folded on the dry shelf beneath the washbasin.

key_facts: Hot water for showers is available around the clock.
run the water for about twenty seconds
cases.notes: 用凌晨洗澡场景代替全天热水的直接问法。

cases.question: 带娃睡得早，晚上走廊会不会一直吵？

knowledge.question_zh: 民宿的安静时段是什么时候？
knowledge.answer_zh: 22:00至次日08:00为全楼安静时段。走廊和共享区域请轻声通行，不使用外放音箱。
knowledge.question_en: What are the property's quiet hours?
knowledge.answer_en: Quiet hours throughout the building are from 10:00 p.m. to 8:00 a.m. Keep voices low in corridors and shared areas, and do not use speakers there.

knowledge.answer_zh: 一楼餐区有两把儿童餐椅，使用后请擦净并放回原处。
knowledge.question_en: How can I use a high chair?
knowledge.answer_en: Two high chairs are kept in the first-floor dining area; wipe them and return them after use.

knowledge.answer_zh: 走廊夜间保留低亮度感应灯，经过时会自动亮起。
knowledge.question_en: Are corridor lights on at night?
knowledge.answer_en: Low-level motion lights remain active in corridors overnight and turn on as someone passes.

key_facts: 22:00至次日08:00为全楼安静时段
走廊和共享区域请轻声通行
cases.notes: 从早睡儿童的担忧召回安静时段。

cases.question: 轻装来，洗头刷牙这些还得自己买吗？

knowledge.question_zh: 房间提供哪些洗漱用品？
knowledge.answer_zh: 客房提供洗发水、沐浴露和一次性牙刷套装，不提供护发素、剃须刀或化妆品。
knowledge.question_en: Which toiletries are provided?
knowledge.answer_en: Rooms provide shampoo, body wash, and a disposable toothbrush kit. Conditioner, razors, and cosmetics are not provided.

knowledge.answer_zh: 按登记入住人数准备浴巾和面巾各一条。
knowledge.question_en: Are towels provided?
knowledge.answer_en: One bath towel and one face towel are prepared for each registered guest.

knowledge.answer_zh: 公共用品柜备有少量针线包，用完请归还剪刀。
knowledge.question_en: Is there a sewing kit?
knowledge.answer_en: A few sewing kits are kept in the shared supply cupboard; return the scissors after use.

key_facts: 客房提供洗发水、沐浴露和一次性牙刷套装
不提供护发素、剃须刀或化妆品
cases.notes: 用轻装出行的需求表达召回洗护用品清单。

cases.question: Could I keep the room until mid-afternoon on departure day?

knowledge.answer_zh: 标准退房时间为12:00。延迟退房须视当天安排确认，每延长一小时收费50元，最晚只能到14:00；请在前一天20:00前提出。
knowledge.question_en: Is late check-out available?
knowledge.answer_en: Standard check-out is at noon. Late check-out must be confirmed against that day's schedule and costs CNY 50 per extended hour, with 2:00 p.m. as the latest possible departure. Ask before 8:00 p.m. on the previous day.

knowledge.answer_zh: 退房当天可寄存至18:00，每人限一件封口行李。
knowledge.question_en: How long can luggage be stored after check-out?
knowledge.answer_en: One sealed piece per guest may be stored until 6:00 p.m. on the check-out day.

knowledge.question_zh: 退房后还能在客厅坐一会儿吗？
knowledge.answer_zh: 办理退房后可在一楼等候区短暂休息至18:00，但请勿占用餐桌用餐。
knowledge.question_en: May I wait in the lounge after check-out?
knowledge.answer_en: After checking out, guests may briefly use the first-floor waiting area until 6:00 p.m., but may not occupy dining tables for a meal.

cases.question: 想坐外面看江，房间推门就有露台吗？

knowledge.answer_zh: 只有两间江景大床房带小阳台，其余五间客房没有私用阳台；所有住客都可使用三楼公共观景台。
knowledge.question_en: Does every room have a balcony?
knowledge.answer_en: Only two river-view queen rooms have a small balcony. The other five rooms have no private balcony; all guests may use the shared third-floor viewing terrace.

knowledge.answer_zh: 江景房侧窗可限位开启，落地固定窗不能打开。
knowledge.question_en: Do the river-view room windows open?
knowledge.answer_en: The side window opens with a restrictor; the full-height fixed pane does not open.

knowledge.answer_zh: 观景台可带无汤汁的简餐，离开时须带走垃圾。
knowledge.question_en: May guests eat on the shared terrace?
knowledge.answer_en: Guests may bring a simple meal without liquids to the viewing terrace and must remove their rubbish afterward.

key_facts: 只有两间江景大床房带小阳台
其余五间客房没有私用阳台

cases.question: 两岁娃爱乱开窗，屋里有没有防护？

knowledge.question_zh: 客房窗户有儿童防护吗？
knowledge.answer_zh: 可开启的客房窗均装有限位器，最大开启约十厘米；这不能替代成人看护。民宿不提供床护栏。
knowledge.question_en: Do room windows have child-safety protection?
knowledge.answer_en: Openable room windows have restrictors limiting the gap to about ten centimetres. This does not replace adult supervision. The property does not provide bed rails.

knowledge.answer_zh: 只提供成人均码拖鞋，儿童鞋请自行准备。
knowledge.question_en: Are children's slippers provided?
knowledge.answer_en: Only one-size adult slippers are provided; please bring footwear for children.

knowledge.answer_zh: 公共楼梯没有儿童安全门，幼儿经过时需由成人陪同。
knowledge.question_en: Is there a gate at the stairs?
knowledge.answer_en: There is no child gate on the shared staircase; an adult must accompany young children there.

key_facts: 可开启的客房窗均装有限位器

cases.question: 连住四晚，中间床单脏了能换吗？

knowledge.question_zh: 连住期间多久更换一次床品？
knowledge.answer_zh: 连续入住时，每满三晚安排一次基础清洁，并包含一次床品更换。若在计划外要求额外更换，额外更换整套床品每次收费20元。
knowledge.question_en: How often is bedding changed during a longer stay?
knowledge.answer_en: For continuous stays, basic cleaning is arranged after every three nights and includes one bedding change. An extra unscheduled full set costs CNY 20 each time.

knowledge.answer_zh: 将湿毛巾放进浴室篮并在当天11:00前留言，可免费更换一次。
knowledge.question_en: Can damp towels be replaced?
knowledge.answer_en: Place damp towels in the bathroom basket and message before 11:00 a.m. for one free replacement.

knowledge.answer_zh: 公共晾晒架只供住客小件衣物使用，请勿晾挂民宿床品。
knowledge.question_en: May guests hang sheets to dry?
knowledge.answer_en: The shared drying rack is for guests' small personal items only; property bedding must not be hung there.

cases.question: The lights just went out in my room. What should I do first?

knowledge.answer_zh: 先确认取电卡已插稳，再观察走廊照明是否正常。不要自行打开配电箱；完成这两步后仍无电，请通过住客聊天联系值守人员。
knowledge.question_en: What should I do if power suddenly goes out in my room?
knowledge.answer_en: First make sure the power card is seated firmly, then check whether the corridor lights are working. Do not open the electrical panel yourself. If power is still out after those checks, contact the duty host through the guest chat.

knowledge.answer_zh: 床头两侧各有独立按键，总控只关闭客房主灯。
knowledge.question_en: How do I turn off the bedside lamp?
knowledge.answer_en: Each bedside lamp has its own button; the master switch controls only the main room light.

knowledge.answer_zh: 床头柜上方各有一个五孔插座和一个USB-A接口。
knowledge.question_en: Are there sockets by the bed?
knowledge.answer_en: Above each bedside table is one universal socket and one USB-A port.

key_facts: First make sure the power card is seated firmly

cases.question: 半夜口渴，房里哪儿能接能直接喝的水？

knowledge.answer_zh: 每间房每天补充两瓶瓶装水；二楼茶水区另有过滤饮水机，可用自带水杯接取常温水。
knowledge.question_en: Is drinking water provided?
knowledge.answer_en: Two bottles of water are replenished in each room daily. A filtered dispenser in the second-floor tea area also provides room-temperature water for guests with their own cups.

knowledge.answer_zh: 客房配有电热水壶，使用前请确认壶内水位高于最低刻度。
knowledge.question_en: Where can I boil water?
knowledge.answer_en: Rooms have an electric kettle; make sure the water is above the minimum line before use.

knowledge.answer_zh: 二楼茶水区全天可进入，22:00后请勿使用会发出较大声响的器具。
knowledge.question_en: Is the tea area open at night?
knowledge.answer_en: The second-floor tea area is accessible at all hours; after 10:00 p.m., avoid appliances that make significant noise.

key_facts: 二楼茶水区另有过滤饮水机
可用自带水杯接取常温水

cases.question: Can a courier leave a small package before I arrive?

knowledge.answer_zh: 可在入住当天10:00至18:00代收已付款的小件包裹，外包装须写住客称呼和入住日期。生鲜、冷冻件及到付件不收，最多保管48小时。
knowledge.question_en: Can the property receive a parcel for me?
knowledge.answer_en: A prepaid small parcel may be received between 10:00 a.m. and 6:00 p.m. on the arrival day. The package must show the guest alias and arrival date. Fresh, frozen, and cash-on-delivery items are not accepted, and storage is limited to 48 hours.

knowledge.answer_zh: 民宿不接收物流托运的大件行李，请由住客本人到店时携带。
knowledge.question_en: Can I ship a large suitcase ahead?
knowledge.answer_en: The property does not accept large luggage sent by freight; guests must bring it when they arrive.

knowledge.answer_zh: 值守人员会在10:00至18:00处理现场事务，但可能短时离开公共区域。
knowledge.question_en: Is someone always at the desk during the day?
knowledge.answer_en: A host handles on-site matters from 10:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. but may briefly step away from the shared area.

knowledge.answer_zh: 客房智能电视支持Miracast和AirPlay；手机与电视需连接同一个住客Wi-Fi。民宿不代登录个人视频账号。
knowledge.question_en: Can I cast from my phone to the room television?
knowledge.answer_en: Room smart televisions support Miracast and AirPlay. The phone and television must use the same guest Wi-Fi. The property cannot sign in to a guest's personal streaming account.

knowledge.answer_zh: 电视侧面有HDMI接口，但房内不提供连接线。

knowledge.answer_en: The television has a side HDMI port, but no cable is supplied in the room.

cases.question: 民宿发生火警时怎么撤离？

knowledge.question_zh: 民宿发生火警时怎么撤离？
knowledge.answer_zh: 听到持续火警警报、看到明火或闻到明显焦煳味时，应把撤离放在第一位，不要先收拾行李，也不要等待他人确认是否真的起火。立即穿上便于行走的鞋，随手拿取手机和房卡即可；证件、电脑、充电器及其他物品留在房内。离开前如果火源不在门边，可快速提醒同住人并关闭正在使用的电器，但不要为此延误。先用手背轻触房门和门把手：如果发烫、门缝有烟或外面传来强烈燃烧声，不要开门，应退回房内，用湿布封住门缝，到窗边发出求救信号并联系消防救援。如果门不烫，先蹲低身体，只开一条小缝观察走廊；走廊清晰时再离开，并随手关门，关门是为了减缓烟气扩散，不要反锁。撤离只使用公共楼梯，绝不乘坐电梯，也不要进入标有工作人员专用的储物通道。二楼住客沿走廊绿色疏散标识前往东侧楼梯；三楼住客优先走靠观景台一端的西侧楼梯，如果该方向有烟，则转向东侧楼梯。楼梯内要靠右、逐层向下，不逆行，不奔跑，不停下来拍摄。遇到烟气时尽量贴近地面，用衣物遮住口鼻，但不要因为寻找湿毛巾而折返。同行有儿童时，由一名成人牵领儿童，另一名成人走在队尾；不要让儿童独自跑下楼。行动缓慢或需要协助的住客，应在预订后提前告知；警报发生时，同住人先陪同其移动到最近的防火门内侧，同时向值守人员报告所在楼层和人数。房门外已经被浓烟封住时，留在房内通常比冲入烟中更安全：关闭空调和排风，封堵门缝，保持低位，使用手机说明房号、人数和窗户朝向。不要从窗户跳下，也不要攀爬外墙、雨棚或排水管。到达一楼后，从主入口或标有疏散出口的侧门离开，继续走到院外白色集合牌旁；不要聚集在门口，以免挡住消防人员。发现同伴未到时，只把姓名或房号和最后出现位置告诉值守人员或消防人员，不自行返回寻找。即使警报暂时停止，也必须等现场消防人员或值守负责人明确宣布可以返回后再进入。若看到小范围冒烟，可以在安全撤离后告知位置；没有受过训练时不要尝试使用灭火器，更不要用水处理电器或油类起火。拨打消防电话时，应说明民宿名称“江岸小筑”、所在楼层、可见烟火及是否有人受困；完整位置以现场张贴的地址为准，不凭记忆编造门牌。集合期间请保持通道畅通，照看同行儿童，不点名传播未经确认的伤情。如果撤离途中手机或房卡掉落，不要停下捡拾；到达安全区域后再把遗失情况告诉值守人员。同行人员应始终一起移动，不为寻找另一条更熟悉的路线脱离疏散标识。冬季或雨天也不要回房取外套和雨具，集合点需要等候时由现场人员安排临时遮蔽。有人轻微擦伤或吸入烟气后感到不适，应在安全地点说明症状并接受专业人员判断，不自行返回房间休息。不要围观急救，也不要拍摄其他住客。清点以实际房号和入住人数为准，同行人不能只说“应该都出来了”；发现名单信息有误时立即纠正。消防车辆到达后，住客应远离车辆通道、消防栓和水带铺设区域，按指示移动集合位置。任何人声称已安全关闭火源，都不能替代消防人员的复查。等待清点时保持手机可以接听，但不要反复拨打值守人员电话，以免占用报告受困信息的通道；需要离开集合区接受治疗时先告知负责清点的人。到达集合点后，请按房号向值守人员报平安，不要自行返回楼内取物。值守人员完成清点并不等于风险解除，是否重新进入只听从消防救援人员的现场指令。
knowledge.question_en: How should guests evacuate if there is a fire alarm?
knowledge.answer_en: If you hear a continuous fire alarm, see flames, or smell strong burning, evacuation comes first. Do not pack and do not wait for someone else to confirm that the fire is real. Put on shoes suitable for walking and take only your phone and room card; leave identification, computers, chargers, and other belongings in the room. If the source is not near the door, you may quickly alert the people staying with you and switch off an appliance already in use, but do not delay for either task. Touch the room door and handle with the back of your hand. If they are hot, smoke is coming through the gap, or intense burning can be heard outside, do not open the door. Return inside, seal the door gap with damp cloth, signal from the window, and contact fire rescue. If the door is cool, crouch low and open it only a crack to inspect the corridor. Leave only if the corridor is clear, then close the door behind you without locking it; closing it slows smoke. Use only the shared stairs. Never use the lift and never enter a storage passage marked for staff. Guests on the second floor follow the green evacuation signs to the east stair. Guests on the third floor should first use the west stair near the viewing terrace; if smoke blocks that direction, turn to the east stair. Keep right, move down one floor at a time, do not run against the flow, and do not stop to film. In smoke, stay as low as practical and cover your nose and mouth with clothing, but never turn back merely to find a wet towel. With children, one adult leads them by the hand and another adult follows at the rear; children must not run downstairs alone. A guest with limited mobility should tell the property after booking. During an alarm, a companion should first help that guest to the protected side of the nearest fire door and report the floor and number of people to the duty host. When heavy smoke has already cut off the corridor, staying in the room is generally safer than entering the smoke: turn off air conditioning and extraction, seal the door gap, remain low, and use the phone to state the room number, number of occupants, and window direction. Do not jump from a window or climb an outside wall, canopy, or drainpipe. On reaching the ground floor, leave through the main entrance or the side door marked as an evacuation exit, then continue to the white assembly sign outside the courtyard. Do not gather at the doorway, because emergency crews need clear access. If a companion is missing, give the duty host or firefighters the person's name or room number and last known location; do not go back to search. Even if the alarm stops, return only after firefighters or the duty lead explicitly says re-entry is permitted. Report the location of a small area of smoke only after reaching safety. If you are not trained, do not attempt to use an extinguisher, and never use water on an electrical or cooking-oil fire. When calling fire rescue, state the property name Jiang'an Cottage, the floor, visible smoke or flame, and whether anyone is trapped. Read the full location from the posted address and never invent a street number from memory. Keep access clear at the assembly area, supervise children, and do not circulate unconfirmed injury reports. If a phone or room card is dropped during evacuation, do not stop to retrieve it; report the loss after reaching safety. People travelling together should keep moving together and must not leave the marked route to seek a more familiar path. In winter or rain, do not return for a coat or umbrella; on-scene personnel will arrange temporary shelter if the assembly wait is long. Anyone with a graze or discomfort after smoke exposure should describe the symptoms at a safe location and let professionals assess them instead of returning to a room to rest. Do not crowd around first aid or film other guests. The headcount uses actual room numbers and registered occupancy, so a companion saying everyone is probably out is not enough; correct any list error immediately. Once fire vehicles arrive, stay clear of access lanes, hydrants, and laid hose, and move the assembly area if directed. A claim that the source has been switched off never replaces inspection by firefighters. Keep your phone available and audible during the headcount, but do not repeatedly call the duty host and block reports about trapped people. If you must leave the assembly area for treatment, first tell the person recording the headcount. At the assembly point, report safe by room number to the duty host and do not return inside for belongings. A completed headcount does not mean the danger has ended; re-entry depends only on instructions from the fire service on scene.

cases.question: 屋顶观景台下雨后还能上去吗，带孩子要注意什么？

knowledge.question_zh: 三楼观景台在什么情况下开放，儿童怎样使用？
knowledge.answer_zh: 三楼观景台供已登记住客在天气和地面条件允许时使用，常规开放时间为07:00至21:30。入口旁的状态牌显示绿色“开放”时方可进入；显示黄色“湿滑观察”或红色“关闭”时，都不能越过挂链。开放时间只是一般时段，并不保证每天都会开放，值守人员可因强风、雷电、暴雨、结冰、维修或邻近施工随时提前关闭。看到乌云、听到雷声或收到大风提示时，即使状态牌尚未更换，也应立即离开平台并回到室内。平台没有遮雨棚，雨伞在阵风中容易失控，不能把撑伞当成继续停留的防护措施。地面由木塑板和防滑砖组成，降雨、露水和清洁后都可能局部湿滑；不要赤脚、穿一次性拖鞋或鞋底磨平的鞋进入。门口备有吸水垫，但吸水垫不代表外侧已经干燥。儿童必须始终由成人近距离陪同，六岁以下儿童应由成人牵手通行；一名成人最多同时照看两名儿童。不得抱儿童坐在栏杆、花箱、桌面或台阶边缘，也不要让儿童攀爬栏杆、追逐、骑滑板车或把玩折叠家具。婴儿车可以停在入口内侧指定位置，但不能推到狭窄观景边，也不能堵住疏散门。栏杆符合日常使用要求，但不能代替成人看护；发现栏杆松动、地板翘起或照明损坏时，应立刻退出并通过住客聊天报告，不要自行搬动或修理。平台只允许安静观景和短暂停留，不举办聚会，不使用外放音箱，不点蜡烛、烟花、蚊香或任何明火。可携带有盖饮料和不易洒落的简餐，玻璃杯、玻璃瓶、汤锅和烧烤设备不得带入。食物碎屑和包装离开时要一并带走，以免招来鸟类或造成滑倒。家具按地面标记摆放，不得拖到栏杆边；若需移动椅子，应抬起而不是在地面拖行，使用完放回原位。拍照时手机、相机和自拍杆都要在栏杆内侧操作，禁止翻越或把身体探出栏杆寻找角度。21:00后请降低谈话音量，21:30前完成离场；关闭状态下不因拍照几分钟、孩子想看江景或物品遗落而例外开放。若个人物品掉到平台关闭区域、屋檐或外墙一侧，应联系值守人员处理，住客不得跨越挂链或攀爬取回。宠物即使装在背包或推车内也不进入平台，以避免惊扰他人和突然挣脱。下雨停止不代表平台马上恢复开放，工作人员需要检查积水、风力、栏杆和照明，并根据地面干燥程度更新状态牌。检查期间即使入口门没有上锁，也不表示住客可以进入；挂链、状态牌和工作人员口头提示具有同样的关闭效力。工作人员会先清除明显积水，再检查板缝、台阶边缘和家具脚下这些较晚干燥的位置。若风仍会推动空椅、栏杆上残留水珠或照明线路正在检查，平台继续关闭。住客不能自行挪开吸水垫、警示锥或挂链来帮助“加快开放”，也不能用客房毛巾擦地后要求进入。多人同行时不要让一人先上去试走，儿童尤其不能作为判断地面是否防滑的测试者。清洁作业刚完成也按湿滑状态处理，需等值守人员确认清洁剂和水迹已经清除。日落后光线会让薄水膜不易看见，因此夜间检查可能比白天等待更久。状态牌更新前，住客可在室内公共区等候，但不得堵住观景台门口反复催促。等待期间不要把鞋、玩具或婴儿车留在门边占位；重新检查没有固定时长，值守人员会在条件满足后主动更新状态。雨停后也要等工作人员解除湿滑提示，不能只凭肉眼觉得地面干了就进入。重新开放后仍应避开有警示锥的局部区域，儿童也不能把警示锥当玩具移动。离开前确认随身物品齐全，成人最后通过门口，并确保儿童已经进入室内；任何时候都不要为了取回遗落物让儿童单独留在平台。
knowledge.question_en: When is the third-floor viewing terrace open, and how may children use it?
knowledge.answer_en: The third-floor viewing terrace is for registered guests only when weather and surface conditions permit. Normal hours are 7:00 a.m. to 9:30 p.m. Enter only when the status sign beside the door shows green and says Open. Do not cross the chain when the sign shows yellow for a slippery-surface check or red for Closed. The stated hours are a general window, not a promise that the terrace opens every day. The duty host may close it early for strong wind, lightning, heavy rain, ice, maintenance, or nearby construction. If you see storm clouds, hear thunder, or receive a high-wind warning, leave immediately and go indoors even if the sign has not yet been changed. There is no rain canopy. An umbrella can become difficult to control in gusts and is not protection that permits guests to remain outside. The floor combines composite decking and slip-resistant tile, but rain, dew, and recent cleaning can still leave wet patches. Do not enter barefoot, in disposable slippers, or in shoes with worn soles. An absorbent mat is placed at the entrance, but it does not prove that the outer surface is dry. Children must remain within close reach of an adult at all times, and children under six must be held by the hand while walking. One adult may supervise no more than two children at once. Never seat a child on a railing, planter, table, or step edge. Children may not climb, chase one another, ride scooters, or play with folding furniture. A stroller may be parked in the marked space inside the entrance, but it may not be pushed to the narrow viewing edge or block the evacuation door. The railing is suitable for ordinary use but never replaces supervision. If a railing feels loose, a board has lifted, or a light is damaged, leave at once and report it through guest chat; do not move or repair anything yourself. The terrace is for quiet viewing and short stays. Parties, loudspeakers, candles, fireworks, mosquito coils, and all other open flames are prohibited. Drinks must have lids, and only food unlikely to spill may be brought up. Glasses, glass bottles, soup pots, and barbecue equipment are not allowed. Remove crumbs and packaging when leaving to avoid attracting birds or creating a slip hazard. Furniture follows floor markings and must not be dragged toward the railing. Lift a chair rather than scraping it across the surface, then return it to its marked position. Phones, cameras, and selfie sticks must remain on the inside of the railing; do not climb over or lean the body outside for a photograph. Lower conversation volume after 9:00 p.m. and finish leaving by 9:30 p.m. A closed terrace does not reopen as an exception for a quick photograph, a child's wish to see the river, or a forgotten item. If property falls into a closed section, onto the eave, or outside the wall, contact the duty host; never cross a chain or climb to retrieve it. Pets do not enter even in a carrier or stroller, because they may disturb others or escape unexpectedly. Rain stopping does not mean the terrace reopens immediately. Staff must inspect standing water, wind, railings, and lighting, then update the sign according to how the surface dries. During inspection, an unlocked entrance door does not mean guests may enter; the chain, sign, and a staff instruction each carry the same closed status. Staff first remove visible water, then check board joints, step edges, and the space beneath furniture legs, which dry later. The terrace stays closed if wind still moves an empty chair, droplets remain on the railing, or the lighting circuit is being inspected. Guests must not move an absorbent mat, warning cone, or chain to help speed reopening, and may not wipe the floor with room towels and then request entry. A group must not send one person up to test the surface, and a child must never be used to judge whether it is slippery. Recent cleaning is treated as a wet-surface condition until the duty host confirms that cleaning solution and water marks are gone. After sunset, a thin film of water is harder to see, so the evening inspection may take longer than a daytime one. Guests may wait in the indoor shared area until the sign changes, but must not block the terrace entrance while repeatedly asking for access. Do not leave shoes, toys, or a stroller by the door to hold a place. Reinspection has no fixed duration; the duty host updates the sign when conditions are met. After rain, wait until staff remove the slippery-surface notice; a guest's visual judgment that the floor looks dry is not enough. When the terrace reopens, avoid any local area still marked by warning cones, and do not let children move those cones as toys. Before leaving, check all belongings, let the adult pass through the door last, and make sure every child is indoors. Never leave a child alone on the terrace while retrieving a forgotten item.

knowledge.question_zh: 多间客房同时想做饭时，共享厨房怎样使用？
knowledge.answer_zh: 一楼共享厨房仅供已登记住客在07:30至21:30准备简单餐食。请在入口旁的白板预约时段，每一格代表三十分钟；每间客房一次最多连续预约两格。没有被预约的空档可以直接使用，但下一间客房的预约开始时，必须按时让出台面和电器。不得擦掉其他房号，也不能用多个分散时段占住整个晚上。厨房内最多同时容纳四人，等候者也计入人数，儿童必须由成人陪同；入口和通往消防出口的标记通道要保持畅通。住客可以使用电磁炉、微波炉、热水壶、水槽、基础锅具以及冰箱中标为“住客”的层架。烤箱、上锁的柜子、标有员工字样的容器和维修插座不对住客开放。食材和调味品须自备；没有写本人房号的瓶罐也不属于共享物品，不能品尝或移动。生食与即食食品要分开处理，生肉使用有颜色标记的砧板，转换操作前清洗双手和器具。贝类和其他强过敏原不用时应密封，打开前告知同时使用厨房的人，但不能把厨房描述为无过敏原环境。禁止油炸、明火、便携燃气炉、烟熏食物和会留下持久气味的烹饪。煮汤、煮饭或任何电器工作时都不能返回客房，开启加热后须一直留在厨房。若出现烟雾，在安全的情况下先断电，随后离开并联系值守人员；不得向电器或燃烧的油泼水。做饭时开启排风，雨水向室内飘时关闭窗户。预约结束前须关闭电器、洗净并擦干锅具、清除台面油水、清理水槽滤网，并把垃圾扎好放入厨房垃圾桶。不能因为清洁开始得晚而拖延下一位住客，清洁时间应包含在预约时段内。放入冰箱的食物须密封，并标注房号和离店日期；没有标签的物品，以及超过标注离店日12:00仍未取走的物品，会由工作人员清理。冷冻层只用于冰袋，不存放餐食。公共杯盘留在厨房使用，民宿不提供外带餐盒；发现餐具破裂或电器故障时应报告，不要放回原位。所有时段都已被预约时，请另选空档，值守人员不会给住客排序，也不会取消在先的有效预约。临近安静时段应避免剁硬质食材、使用搅拌机或聚集在门口。电磁炉会在21:30断电，即使餐食尚未完成也不延长；晚开始不能获得额外供电，食物也不能留在厨房整夜烹煮。最后一个时段结束后，清空台面，把个人食物放回有标签的冰箱层或在安全的情况下带回客房，关闭排风和照明，并确认厨房门口没有物品阻挡。
knowledge.question_en: How does the shared kitchen work if several rooms want to cook?
knowledge.answer_en: The first-floor shared kitchen is for registered guests preparing simple meals between 7:30 a.m. and 9:30 p.m. Use the whiteboard beside the entrance to reserve a slot. Each line represents thirty minutes, and a room may book no more than two consecutive slots at a time. An unreserved slot may be used without advance notice, but the counter and appliances must be released promptly when another room's reservation begins. Do not erase another room number or reserve several separated blocks to hold the kitchen for an entire evening. The room holds no more than four people, including anyone waiting, and children must stay with an adult. Keep the doorway and the marked path to the fire exit clear. Guests may use the induction hob, microwave, kettle, sink, basic pans, and the shelf in the refrigerator marked Guest. The oven, locked cupboards, staff-labelled containers, and maintenance sockets are not for guest use. Bring your own food and seasonings. A bottle or container without your room number is not shared property and must not be tasted or moved. Separate raw ingredients from ready-to-eat food, use the colour-marked board for raw meat, and wash hands and utensils before changing tasks. Shellfish and strong allergens should remain sealed when not being prepared; tell other guests in the room before opening them, but the kitchen cannot be represented as allergen-free. Deep-frying, open flames, tabletop gas burners, smoking food, and cooking that produces persistent odour are prohibited. Do not leave soup, rice, or any appliance running while returning to a guest room. Stay in the kitchen whenever heat is on. If smoke appears, switch off power if it is safe, leave the area, and contact the duty host; never pour water onto an electrical appliance or burning oil. Use the extractor while cooking and close the window if rain is blowing inward. When a slot ends, turn off appliances, wash and dry the cookware, wipe oil and water from the counter, clear the sink strainer, and place rubbish in the tied kitchen bin. Another guest's reservation is not delayed because cleaning started late, so allow cleanup time within the booked period. Refrigerator items must be sealed and labelled with the room number and check-out date. Staff remove unlabelled items and anything remaining after noon on its stated departure date. The freezer is reserved for ice packs and is not for storing meals. Shared mugs and plates stay in the kitchen; take-away containers are not supplied. Report a cracked dish or faulty appliance instead of putting it back. If every slot is occupied, choose another open time; the host does not rank guests or cancel an earlier valid booking. Quiet-hour preparation should avoid chopping hard ingredients, using a blender, or gathering in the doorway. The induction hob switches off at 9:30 p.m., even if a meal is unfinished. Power is not extended for a late start, and food must not be left to finish cooking overnight. After the final slot, leave the counter empty, take personal food back to the labelled refrigerator shelf or room where safe, switch off the extractor and lights, and make sure the kitchen door remains unobstructed.

knowledge.answer_en: Bookings that include breakfast may choose a delivery window between 7:30 and 9:00 a.m.; the light meal is placed on the first-floor collection rack.

knowledge.question_zh: 凌晨到店可以自助进入吗？
knowledge.answer_zh: 已完成身份确认的住客会收到自助进入指引，预计午夜后到达须提前告知。
knowledge.question_en: Can I enter by myself after midnight?
knowledge.answer_en: Guests who have completed identity confirmation receive self-entry instructions and must give advance notice if arriving after midnight.

knowledge.question_zh: 大件行李可以托运到民宿吗？
knowledge.answer_zh: 民宿不接收物流托运的大件行李。
knowledge.question_en: Can large luggage be shipped to the property?
knowledge.answer_en: The property does not receive large luggage sent by freight.

cases.question: 我开车带猫，凌晨一点到，还能进门、停车和入住吗？

knowledge.question_zh: 午夜后到店还能入住吗？
knowledge.answer_zh: 身份确认完成后可按自助指引进入；预计午夜后到达须在当天20:00前告知，前台夜间不值守。
knowledge.question_en: Can I check in after midnight?
knowledge.answer_en: After identity confirmation, guests may enter using the self-entry guide. Arrival after midnight must be reported before 8:00 p.m. that day, and the desk is not staffed overnight.

knowledge.answer_zh: 院门内有两个普通小车位，先到先停，不接受预留；满位后民宿不保证其他车位。
knowledge.question_en: Where can a driving guest park?
knowledge.answer_en: There are two ordinary car spaces inside the courtyard gate, first come, first served, with no reservations. The property cannot guarantee another space when they are full.

knowledge.answer_zh: 民宿不接待猫、狗及其他宠物入住；服务动物请在预订前联系人工确认安排。
knowledge.question_en: May I stay with a cat?
knowledge.answer_en: Cats, dogs, and other pets are not accepted. For a service animal, contact a human before booking to confirm arrangements.

knowledge.answer_zh: 院门22:30后保持关闭，已入住住客按门禁指引通行。
knowledge.question_en: Is the courtyard gate closed at night?
knowledge.answer_en: The courtyard gate remains closed after 10:30 p.m.; checked-in guests follow their access instructions.
